notableRisks: Atlético played extensive 3-5-2; nominal 4-4-2 display maps Carrasco as LW, Lodi as LB, Llorente as RW, Correa as ST; majority positional role and 3-back group not fully audited.
Barcelona changed to 3-center-back shape under Koeman; Messi on RW for website position despite inward/central actual roles; Mingueza RCB/RB split not audited.
Madrid Lucas Vázquez filled RB for part-season; Carvajal frequently injured.
Sevilla Papu Gómez LW/RW/CAM role after winter move requires per-match study; shown as RW backup proxy.
Sociedad Silva in CAM but injury-limited, Guevara/Zubimendi DM and Portu RW roles provisional.
Betis 4-2-3-1 with Canales often RW/CM, Fekir CAM, Aitor Ruibal RW; mapping provisional.
Villarreal Rulli had just two La Liga starts but UEFA Europa League final as starting goalkeeper; included as backup with league limitations rather than claiming league starts.
Site 4-4-2 XI position constraints may exclude excellent players, e.g. Gerard Moreno 23 league goals; independently compare with Suárez/Benzema.
